line-03.title: Add nothing, subtract nothing
paragraphs: The essence of our open-baffle loudspeakers lies in sonic integrity and in a formal purity dictated by function. This design favors clarity and depth over brute power, in pursuit of uncompromising fidelity.

line-04.title: “Honesty, utility, simplicity.”
paragraphs: Our approach draws on the ethos of minimal art, a reaction to the complexity of Abstract Expressionism. The minimalist movement seeks to focus on the essential by removing unnecessary details and distractions. This is the starting point for our approach: reproducing sound without artifacts.

line-05.title: Music set free
paragraphs:
A single driver reproduces bass, midrange, and treble. This point source delivers precise imaging and exceptionally consistent timbre.

The design also eliminates the crossover and its associated issues. The driver requires little power for home listening.

This technology delivers fast transients and microdynamics, resulting in outstanding energy and vitality.

line-06.title: Sonic transparency
paragraphs:
We solve problems by removing their causes and stripping away everything that clutters the object. One driver, no cabinet, no electronic components.

Instead of an enclosure, the design uses an acrylic panel and a purpose-built driver. PMMA inherently has low resonance, and the open-baffle design also eliminates standing waves at their source.

line-07.title: The voice is sublime
paragraphs:
Tabula rasa offers a high degree of resolution without causing listening fatigue; on the contrary, the sound is smooth and nuanced.

Honesty compels us to say that it favors the midrange over spectacular effects. Yet the midrange conveys 80% of the emotion, and in this respect Tabula rasa is second to none.

line-08.title: Choosing finesse
paragraphs:
An amplifier of the utmost refinement is essential; power matters little: 2 × 2 W or 3 W is enough.
We can recommend perfectly matched models.

specs.sustainableBody: No planned obsolescence: durability is central to the design. Recycled and recyclable acrylic glass is paired with a paper speaker cone. The speaker is designed and carefully manufactured in France.
specs.technicalBody: A 22.5 cm full-range driver provides a point source. Its impedance is 8 Ω and its break-in period is 50 hours. It works with tube amplifiers rated at just 2 or 3 W and handles up to 50 W.
specs.usageNote: This is not a PA system. Designed for home listening, it delivers a pure and intimate sound experience.

line-02.title: tabula rasa
line-02.subtitle: A minimalist loudspeaker focused on precision, speed, and the emotional power of the midrange.

line-02.title: tabula rasa
line-02.subtitle: A refined acoustic object built for clarity and musical immediacy.

paragraphs: Single-driver coherence, open architecture, and controlled resonance define the listening experience.
The midrange conveys emotion through stable imaging and fatigue-free listening.
This technical approach preserves natural dynamics and vivid expression.
